title: An instantaneous voice-synthesis neuroprosthesis
goal: Recreate the original findings and separately exceed them on the same source-paper task: Causal synthesis of attempted cued speech from T15 neural activity, together with the source nonspeech/acoustic-contamination controls and cross-session generalization checks. Fig. 2b acoustic accuracy is the proposed primary prediction endpoint, not a complete replacement of the canonical task.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable submitted analysis and source-native outputs for the complete original finding and companion panel.
Improvement: candidate outputs and a comparison on the same original task under improvement.v1.json.
Separate evidence for both outcomes under matched paper+data and paper+data+author-code conditions.
success_criteria: Assess reproduction and improvement independently under reproduction.v1.json and improvement.v1.json; do not combine their scores.
Preserve the original task, full panel, permitted observations, metrics, aggregation and required companion controls.
Reproduction requires a source-grounded computation and independently verified granular outputs; copying published findings alone is insufficient.
Improvement requires the unchanged improvement contract's same-task comparison, uncertainty and admission rules.
Use outcomes.v1.json for the matched information conditions and budgets; a declared contract or admitted receipt is not scientific qualification.
Author-baseline replay remains calibration. Historical reconstruction attempts retain their original scope and are not promoted to new qualified AI reproduction results.

improvement.improvement_loop: After admission, iterate causal decoder/feature choices using only the original eligible past-session training data and a declared validation allocation that preserves the paper chronology. Record every attempt and all auxiliary speech-model exposure.
improvement.candidate_freeze: Freeze method, training recipe, seed policy, session decoder routing, vocoder, target-independent preprocessing and evaluator before the complete original evaluation is opened.
improvement.final_evaluation: Evaluate one frozen candidate and the matched author baseline on all original evaluation trials. Preserve acoustic replay and closed-loop claims separately; no win is currently executable. The original control and fixed-decoder session-generalization requirements must also be evaluated; the primary acoustic score alone does not satisfy the canonical scope.
improvement.baseline_policy: Use original per-session author decoders or a validated exact recipe replay; keep their measured score separate from the published 0.83. The repository demo and a local authored decoder cannot replace this comparator.

improvement.action: The final paper has an ordered causal neural-to-voice acoustic endpoint and the author release includes session-specific decoders. A same-task design is identifiable, but the original evaluation/session training manifest, matched evaluator, uncertainty rule and budgets are not qualified. The day195 offline demonstration and control-only archive cannot be substituted for the paper evaluation, and offline replay cannot establish improved closed-loop communication. The canonical scope also includes original control trials and cross-session generalization; Fig. 2b correlation alone is insufficient for a whole-registration win until the complete scope rule is bound.
